commands.name: APPEND
commands.description: Appends a string to the value of a key. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

commands.name: DECR
commands.description: Decrements the integer value of a key by one. Uses 0 as initial value if the key doesn't exist.

commands.name: DECRBY
commands.description: Decrements a number from the integer value of a key. Uses 0 as initial value if the key doesn't exist.

commands.name: DELEX
commands.syntax:
DELEX key [IFEQ ifeq-value | IFNE ifne-value | IFDEQ ifdeq-digest |
  IFDNE ifdne-digest]
commands.description: Conditionally removes the specified key based on value or hash digest comparison.

commands.name: DIGEST
commands.description: Returns the hash digest of a string value as a hexadecimal string.

commands.name: GET
commands.description: Returns the string value of a key.

commands.name: GETDEL
commands.description: Returns the string value of a key after deleting the key.

commands.name: GETEX
commands.syntax:
GETEX key [EX seconds | PX milliseconds | EXAT unix-time-seconds |
  PXAT unix-time-milliseconds | PERSIST]
commands.description: Returns the string value of a key after setting its expiration time.

commands.name: GETRANGE
commands.description: Returns a substring of the string stored at a key.

commands.name: GETSET
commands.description: Returns the previous string value of a key after setting it to a new value.

commands.name: INCR
commands.description: Increments the integer value of a key by one. Uses 0 as initial value if the key doesn't exist.

commands.name: INCRBY
commands.description: Increments the integer value of a key by a number. Uses 0 as initial value if the key doesn't exist.

commands.name: INCRBYFLOAT
commands.description: Increment the floating point value of a key by a number. Uses 0 as initial value if the key doesn't exist.

commands.name: INCREX
commands.syntax:
INCREX key [BYFLOAT increment | BYINT increment]
 [LBOUND lowerbound] [UBOUND upperbound] [SATURATE]
 [EX seconds | PX milliseconds | EXAT unix-time-seconds| PXAT unix-time-milliseconds | PERSIST] [ENX]
commands.description: Increments the numeric value of a key by a number and sets its expiration time. Uses 0 as initial value if the key doesn't exist.

commands.name: LCS
commands.description: Finds the longest common substring.

commands.name: MGET
commands.description: Atomically returns the string values of one or more keys.

commands.name: MSET
commands.description: Atomically creates or modifies the string values of one or more keys.

commands.name: MSETEX
commands.syntax:
MSETEX numkeys key value [key value ...] [NX | XX] [EX seconds |
  PX milliseconds | EXAT unix-time-seconds |
  PXAT unix-time-milliseconds | KEEPTTL]
commands.description: Atomically sets multiple string keys with a shared expiration in a single operation.

commands.name: MSETNX
commands.description: Atomically modifies the string values of one or more keys only when all keys don't exist.

commands.name: PSETEX
commands.description: Sets both string value and expiration time in milliseconds of a key. The key is created if it doesn't exist.

commands.name: SET
commands.syntax:
SET key value [NX | XX | IFEQ ifeq-value | IFNE ifne-value |
  IFDEQ ifdeq-digest | IFDNE ifdne-digest] [GET] [EX seconds |
  PX milliseconds | EXAT unix-time-seconds |
  PXAT unix-time-milliseconds | KEEPTTL]
commands.description: Sets the string value of a key, ignoring its type. The key is created if it doesn't exist.

commands.name: SETEX
commands.description: Sets the string value and expiration time of a key. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

commands.name: SETNX
commands.description: Set the string value of a key only when the key doesn't exist.

commands.name: SETRANGE
commands.description: Overwrites a part of a string value with another by an offset. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

commands.name: STRLEN
commands.description: Returns the length of a string value.

commands.name: SUBSTR
commands.description: Returns a substring from a string value.

commands.name: HDEL
commands.description: Deletes one or more fields and their values from a hash. Deletes the hash if no fields remain.

commands.name: HEXISTS
commands.description: Determines whether a field exists in a hash.

commands.name: HEXPIRE
commands.syntax:
HEXPIRE key seconds [NX | XX | GT | LT] FIELDS numfields field
  [field ...]
commands.description: Set expiry for hash field using relative time to expire (seconds)

commands.name: HEXPIREAT
commands.syntax:
HEXPIREAT key unix-time-seconds [NX | XX | GT | LT] FIELDS numfields
  field [field ...]
commands.description: Set expiry for hash field using an absolute Unix timestamp (seconds)

commands.name: HEXPIRETIME
commands.description: Returns the expiration time of a hash field as a Unix timestamp, in seconds.

commands.name: HGET
commands.description: Returns the value of a field in a hash.

commands.name: HGETALL
commands.description: Returns all fields and values in a hash.

commands.name: HGETDEL
commands.description: Returns the value of a field and deletes it from the hash.

commands.name: HGETEX
commands.syntax:
HGETEX key [EX seconds | PX milliseconds | EXAT unix-time-seconds |
  PXAT unix-time-milliseconds | PERSIST] FIELDS numfields field
  [field ...]
commands.description: Get the value of one or more fields of a given hash key, and optionally set their expiration.

commands.name: HIMPORT
commands.description: A container for session-based hash import commands using fieldsets.

commands.name: HIMPORT DISCARD
commands.description: Removes a single session-local fieldset by name.

commands.name: HIMPORT DISCARDALL
commands.description: Removes all session-local fieldsets for the connection.

commands.name: HIMPORT PREPARE
commands.description: Defines a session-local fieldset that maps a name to a sorted set of field names.

commands.name: HIMPORT SET
commands.description: Creates a fieldset-based hash from values supplied in the order matching a previously prepared fieldset.

commands.name: HINCRBY
commands.description: Increments the integer value of a field in a hash by a number. Uses 0 as initial value if the field doesn't exist.

commands.name: HINCRBYFLOAT
commands.description: Increments the floating point value of a field by a number. Uses 0 as initial value if the field doesn't exist.

commands.name: HKEYS
commands.description: Returns all fields in a hash.

commands.name: HLEN
commands.description: Returns the number of fields in a hash.

commands.name: HMGET
commands.description: Returns the values of all fields in a hash.

commands.name: HMSET
commands.description: Sets the values of multiple fields.

commands.name: HPERSIST
commands.description: Removes the expiration time for each specified field

commands.name: HPEXPIRE
commands.syntax:
HPEXPIRE key milliseconds [NX | XX | GT | LT] FIELDS numfields field
  [field ...]
commands.description: Set expiry for hash field using relative time to expire (milliseconds)

commands.name: HPEXPIREAT
commands.syntax:
HPEXPIREAT key unix-time-milliseconds [NX | XX | GT | LT]
  FIELDS numfields field [field ...]
commands.description: Set expiry for hash field using an absolute Unix timestamp (milliseconds)

commands.name: HPEXPIRETIME
commands.description: Returns the expiration time of a hash field as a Unix timestamp, in msec.

commands.name: HPTTL
commands.description: Returns the TTL in milliseconds of a hash field.

commands.name: HRANDFIELD
commands.description: Returns one or more random fields from a hash.

commands.name: HSCAN
commands.description: Iterates over fields and values of a hash.

commands.name: HSET
commands.description: Creates or modifies the value of a field in a hash.

commands.name: HSETEX
commands.syntax:
HSETEX key [FNX | FXX] [EX seconds | PX milliseconds |
  EXAT unix-time-seconds | PXAT unix-time-milliseconds | KEEPTTL]
  FIELDS numfields field value [field value ...]
commands.description: Set the value of one or more fields of a given hash key, and optionally set their expiration.

commands.name: HSETNX
commands.description: Sets the value of a field in a hash only when the field doesn't exist.

commands.name: HSTRLEN
commands.description: Returns the length of the value of a field.

commands.name: HTTL
commands.description: Returns the TTL in seconds of a hash field.

commands.name: HVALS
commands.description: Returns all values in a hash.

commands.name: BLMOVE
commands.syntax: BLMOVE source destination <LEFT | RIGHT> <LEFT | RIGHT> timeout
commands.description: Pops an element from a list, pushes it to another list and returns it. Blocks until an element is available otherwise. Deletes the list if the last element was moved.

commands.name: BLMOVEM
commands.syntax:
BLMOVEM source destination <LEFT | RIGHT> <LEFT | RIGHT> timeout
  [<COUNT count | EXACTLY exactly> <OBO | BULK>]
commands.description: Moves up to (or exactly) a number of elements from one list to another and returns them. Blocks until the elements are available otherwise. Deletes the source list if it becomes empty.

commands.name: BLMPOP
commands.syntax: BLMPOP timeout numkeys key [key ...] <LEFT | RIGHT> [COUNT count]
commands.description: Pops the first element from one of multiple lists. Blocks until an element is available otherwise. Deletes the list if the last element was popped.

commands.name: BLPOP
commands.description: Removes and returns the first element in a list. Blocks until an element is available otherwise. Deletes the list if the last element was popped.

commands.name: BRPOP
commands.description: Removes and returns the last element in a list. Blocks until an element is available otherwise. Deletes the list if the last element was popped.

commands.name: BRPOPLPUSH
commands.description: Pops an element from a list, pushes it to another list and returns it. Block until an element is available otherwise. Deletes the list if the last element was popped.

commands.name: LINDEX
commands.description: Returns an element from a list by its index.

commands.name: LINSERT
commands.description: Inserts an element before or after another element in a list.

commands.name: LLEN
commands.description: Returns the length of a list.

commands.name: LMOVE
commands.description: Returns an element after popping it from one list and pushing it to another. Deletes the list if the last element was moved.

commands.name: LMOVEM
commands.syntax:
LMOVEM source destination <LEFT | RIGHT> <LEFT | RIGHT>
  [<COUNT count | EXACTLY exactly> <OBO | BULK>]
commands.description: Moves up to (or exactly) a number of elements from one list to another and returns them. Deletes the source list if it becomes empty.

commands.name: LMPOP
commands.description: Returns multiple elements from a list after removing them. Deletes the list if the last element was popped.

commands.name: LPOP
commands.description: Returns the first elements in a list after removing it. Deletes the list if the last element was popped.

commands.name: LPOS
commands.syntax: LPOS key element [RANK rank] [COUNT num-matches] [MAXLEN len]
commands.description: Returns the index of matching elements in a list.

commands.name: LPUSH
commands.description: Prepends one or more elements to a list. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

commands.name: LPUSHX
commands.description: Prepends one or more elements to a list only when the list exists.

commands.name: LRANGE
commands.description: Returns a range of elements from a list.

commands.name: LREM
commands.description: Removes elements from a list. Deletes the list if the last element was removed.

commands.name: LSET
commands.description: Sets the value of an element in a list by its index.

commands.name: LTRIM
commands.description: Removes elements from both ends a list. Deletes the list if all elements were trimmed.

commands.name: RPOP
commands.description: Returns and removes the last elements of a list. Deletes the list if the last element was popped.

commands.name: RPOPLPUSH
commands.description: Returns the last element of a list after removing and pushing it to another list. Deletes the list if the last element was popped.

commands.name: RPUSH
commands.description: Appends one or more elements to a list. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

commands.name: RPUSHX
commands.description: Appends an element to a list only when the list exists.

commands.name: SADD
commands.description: Adds one or more members to a set. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

commands.name: SCARD
commands.description: Returns the number of members in a set.

commands.name: SDIFF
commands.description: Returns the difference of multiple sets.

commands.name: SDIFFCARD
commands.description: Returns the number of members of the difference between the first set and all successive sets.

commands.name: SDIFFSTORE
commands.description: Stores the difference of multiple sets in a key.

commands.name: SINTER
commands.description: Returns the intersect of multiple sets.

commands.name: SINTERCARD
commands.description: Returns the number of members of the intersect of multiple sets.

commands.name: SINTERSTORE
commands.description: Stores the intersect of multiple sets in a key.

commands.name: SISMEMBER
commands.description: Determines whether a member belongs to a set.

commands.name: SMEMBERS
commands.description: Returns all members of a set.

commands.name: SMISMEMBER
commands.description: Determines whether multiple members belong to a set.

commands.name: SMOVE
commands.description: Moves a member from one set to another.

commands.name: SPOP
commands.description: Returns one or more random members from a set after removing them. Deletes the set if the last member was popped.

commands.name: SRANDMEMBER
commands.description: Get one or multiple random members from a set

commands.name: SREM
commands.description: Removes one or more members from a set. Deletes the set if the last member was removed.

commands.name: SSCAN
commands.description: Iterates over members of a set.

commands.name: SUNION
commands.description: Returns the union of multiple sets.

commands.name: SUNIONCARD
commands.description: Returns the number of members of the union of multiple sets.

commands.name: SUNIONSTORE
commands.description: Stores the union of multiple sets in a key.

commands.name: BZMPOP
commands.syntax: BZMPOP timeout numkeys key [key ...] <MIN | MAX> [COUNT count]
commands.description: Removes and returns a member by score from one or more sorted sets. Blocks until a member is available otherwise. Deletes the sorted set if the last element was popped.

commands.name: BZPOPMAX
commands.description: Removes and returns the member with the highest score from one or more sorted sets. Blocks until a member available otherwise.  Deletes the sorted set if the last element was popped.

commands.name: BZPOPMIN
commands.description: Removes and returns the member with the lowest score from one or more sorted sets. Blocks until a member is available otherwise. Deletes the sorted set if the last element was popped.

commands.name: ZADD
commands.syntax:
ZADD key [NX | XX] [GT | LT] [CH] [INCR] score member [score member
  ...]
commands.description: Adds one or more members to a sorted set, or updates their scores. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

commands.name: ZCARD
commands.description: Returns the number of members in a sorted set.

commands.name: ZCOUNT
commands.description: Returns the count of members in a sorted set that have scores within a range.

commands.name: ZDIFF
commands.description: Returns the difference between multiple sorted sets.

commands.name: ZDIFFSTORE
commands.description: Stores the difference of multiple sorted sets in a key.

commands.name: ZINCRBY
commands.description: Increments the score of a member in a sorted set.

commands.name: ZINTER
commands.syntax:
ZINTER numkeys key [key ...] [WEIGHTS weight [weight ...]]
  [AGGREGATE <SUM | MIN | MAX | COUNT>] [WITHSCORES]
commands.description: Returns the intersect of multiple sorted sets.

commands.name: ZINTERCARD
commands.description: Returns the number of members of the intersect of multiple sorted sets.

commands.name: ZINTERSTORE
commands.syntax:
ZINTERSTORE destination numkeys key [key ...] [WEIGHTS weight
  [weight ...]] [AGGREGATE <SUM | MIN | MAX | COUNT>]
commands.description: Stores the intersect of multiple sorted sets in a key.

commands.name: ZLEXCOUNT
commands.description: Returns the number of members in a sorted set within a lexicographical range.

commands.name: ZMPOP
commands.description: Returns the highest- or lowest-scoring members from one or more sorted sets after removing them. Deletes the sorted set if the last member was popped.

commands.name: ZMSCORE
commands.description: Returns the score of one or more members in a sorted set.

commands.name: ZPOPMAX
commands.description: Returns the highest-scoring members from a sorted set after removing them. Deletes the sorted set if the last member was popped.

commands.name: ZPOPMIN
commands.description: Returns the lowest-scoring members from a sorted set after removing them. Deletes the sorted set if the last member was popped.

commands.name: ZRANDMEMBER
commands.description: Returns one or more random members from a sorted set.

commands.name: ZRANGE
commands.syntax:
ZRANGE key start stop [BYSCORE | BYLEX] [REV] [LIMIT offset count]
  [WITHSCORES]
commands.description: Returns members in a sorted set within a range of indexes.

commands.name: ZRANGEBYLEX
commands.syntax: ZRANGEBYLEX key min max [LIMIT offset count]
commands.description: Returns members in a sorted set within a lexicographical range.

commands.name: ZRANGEBYSCORE
commands.syntax: ZRANGEBYSCORE key min max [WITHSCORES] [LIMIT offset count]
commands.description: Returns members in a sorted set within a range of scores.

commands.name: ZRANGESTORE
commands.syntax:
ZRANGESTORE dst src min max [BYSCORE | BYLEX] [REV] [LIMIT offset
  count]
commands.description: Stores a range of members from sorted set in a key.

commands.name: ZRANK
commands.description: Returns the index of a member in a sorted set ordered by ascending scores.

commands.name: ZREM
commands.description: Removes one or more members from a sorted set. Deletes the sorted set if all members were removed.

commands.name: ZREMRANGEBYLEX
commands.description: Removes members in a sorted set within a lexicographical range. Deletes the sorted set if all members were removed.

commands.name: ZREMRANGEBYRANK
commands.description: Removes members in a sorted set within a range of indexes. Deletes the sorted set if all members were removed.

commands.name: ZREMRANGEBYSCORE
commands.description: Removes members in a sorted set within a range of scores. Deletes the sorted set if all members were removed.

commands.name: ZREVRANGE
commands.description: Returns members in a sorted set within a range of indexes in reverse order.

commands.name: ZREVRANGEBYLEX
commands.syntax: ZREVRANGEBYLEX key max min [LIMIT offset count]
commands.description: Returns members in a sorted set within a lexicographical range in reverse order.

commands.name: ZREVRANGEBYSCORE
commands.syntax: ZREVRANGEBYSCORE key max min [WITHSCORES] [LIMIT offset count]
commands.description: Returns members in a sorted set within a range of scores in reverse order.

commands.name: ZREVRANK
commands.description: Returns the index of a member in a sorted set ordered by descending scores.

commands.name: ZSCAN
commands.description: Iterates over members and scores of a sorted set.

commands.name: ZSCORE
commands.description: Returns the score of a member in a sorted set.

commands.name: ZUNION
commands.syntax:
ZUNION numkeys key [key ...] [WEIGHTS weight [weight ...]]
  [AGGREGATE <SUM | MIN | MAX | COUNT>] [WITHSCORES]
commands.description: Returns the union of multiple sorted sets.

commands.name: ZUNIONSTORE
commands.syntax:
ZUNIONSTORE destination numkeys key [key ...] [WEIGHTS weight
  [weight ...]] [AGGREGATE <SUM | MIN | MAX | COUNT>]
commands.description: Stores the union of multiple sorted sets in a key.

commands.name: XACK
commands.description: Returns the number of messages that were successfully acknowledged by the consumer group member of a stream.

commands.name: XACKDEL
commands.syntax: XACKDEL key group [KEEPREF | DELREF | ACKED] IDS numids id [id ...]
commands.description: Acknowledges and conditionally deletes one or multiple entries for a stream consumer group.

commands.name: XADD
commands.syntax:
XADD key [NOMKSTREAM] [KEEPREF | DELREF | ACKED]
  [IDMPAUTO producer-id | IDMP producer-id idempotent-id]
  [<MAXLEN | MINID> [= | ~] threshold [LIMIT count]] <* | id>
  field value [field value ...]
commands.description: Appends a new message to a stream. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

commands.name: XAUTOCLAIM
commands.syntax:
XAUTOCLAIM key group consumer min-idle-time start [COUNT count]
  [JUSTID]
commands.description: Changes, or acquires, ownership of messages in a consumer group, as if the messages were delivered to as consumer group member.

commands.name: XCFGSET
commands.description: Sets the IDMP configuration parameters for a stream.

commands.name: XCLAIM
commands.syntax:
XCLAIM key group consumer min-idle-time id [id ...] [IDLE ms]
  [TIME unix-time-milliseconds] [RETRYCOUNT count] [FORCE] [JUSTID]
  [LASTID lastid]
commands.description: Changes, or acquires, ownership of a message in a consumer group, as if the message was delivered a consumer group member.

commands.name: XDEL
commands.description: Returns the number of messages after removing them from a stream.

commands.name: XDELEX
commands.syntax: XDELEX key [KEEPREF | DELREF | ACKED] IDS numids id [id ...]
commands.description: Deletes one or multiple entries from the stream.

commands.name: XGROUP CREATE
commands.description: Creates a consumer group.

commands.name: XGROUP CREATECONSUMER
commands.description: Creates a consumer in a consumer group.

commands.name: XGROUP DELCONSUMER
commands.description: Deletes a consumer from a consumer group.

commands.name: XGROUP DESTROY
commands.description: Destroys a consumer group.

commands.name: XGROUP SETID
commands.description: Sets the last-delivered ID of a consumer group.

commands.name: XIDMPRECORD
commands.description: An internal command for setting IDMP metadata on an existing stream message.

commands.name: XINFO CONSUMERS
commands.description: Returns a list of the consumers in a consumer group.

commands.name: XINFO GROUPS
commands.description: Returns a list of the consumer groups of a stream.

commands.name: XINFO STREAM
commands.description: Returns information about a stream.

commands.name: XLEN
commands.description: Return the number of messages in a stream.

commands.name: XNACK
commands.syntax:
XNACK key group <SILENT | FAIL | FATAL> IDS numids id [id ...]
  [RETRYCOUNT count] [FORCE]
commands.description: Releases pending messages back to the group's PEL without acknowledging them, making them available for re-delivery.

commands.name: XPENDING
commands.syntax: XPENDING key group [[IDLE min-idle-time] start end count [consumer]]
commands.description: Returns the information and entries from a stream consumer group's pending entries list.

commands.name: XRANGE
commands.description: Returns the messages from a stream within a range of IDs.

commands.name: XREAD
commands.syntax:
XREAD [COUNT count] [MAXCOUNT maxcount] [MAXSIZE maxsize]
  [BLOCK milliseconds] STREAMS key [key ...] id [id ...]
commands.description: Returns messages from multiple streams with IDs greater than the ones requested. Blocks until a message is available otherwise.

commands.name: XREADGROUP
commands.syntax:
XREADGROUP GROUP group consumer [COUNT count] [MAXCOUNT maxcount]
  [MAXSIZE maxsize] [BLOCK milliseconds] [CLAIM min-idle-time]
  [NOACK] STREAMS key [key ...] id [id ...]
commands.description: Returns new or historical messages from a stream for a consumer in a group. Blocks until a message is available otherwise.

commands.name: XREVRANGE
commands.description: Returns the messages from a stream within a range of IDs in reverse order.

commands.name: XSETID
commands.description: An internal command for replicating stream values.

commands.name: XTRIM
commands.syntax: XTRIM key <MAXLEN | MINID> [= | ~] threshold [LIMIT count] [KEEPREF | DELREF | ACKED]
commands.description: Deletes messages from the beginning of a stream.

commands.name: BITCOUNT
commands.description: Counts the number of set bits (population counting) in a string.

commands.name: BITFIELD
commands.syntax:
BITFIELD key [GET encoding offset | [OVERFLOW <WRAP | SAT | FAIL>]
  <SET encoding offset value | INCRBY encoding offset increment>
  [GET encoding offset | [OVERFLOW <WRAP | SAT | FAIL>]
  <SET encoding offset value | INCRBY encoding offset increment>
  ...]]
commands.description: Performs arbitrary bitfield integer operations on strings.

commands.name: BITFIELD_RO
commands.syntax: BITFIELD RO key [GET encoding offset [GET encoding offset ...]]
commands.description: Performs arbitrary read-only bitfield integer operations on strings.

commands.name: BITOP
commands.syntax: BITOP <AND | OR | XOR | NOT | DIFF | DIFF1 | ANDOR | ONE> destkey key [key ...]
commands.description: Performs bitwise operations on multiple strings, and stores the result.

commands.name: BITPOS
commands.description: Finds the first set (1) or clear (0) bit in a string.

commands.name: GETBIT
commands.description: Returns a bit value by offset.

commands.name: SETBIT
commands.description: Sets or clears the bit at offset of the string value. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

commands.name: ARCOUNT
commands.description: Returns the number of non-empty elements in an array.

commands.name: ARDEL
commands.description: Deletes elements at the specified indices in an array.

commands.name: ARDELRANGE
commands.description: Deletes elements in one or more ranges.

commands.name: ARGET
commands.description: Gets the value at an index in an array.

commands.name: ARGETRANGE
commands.description: Gets values in a range of indices.

commands.name: ARGREP
commands.syntax:
ARGREP key start end
  <EXACT string | MATCH string | GLOB pattern | RE pattern [...]>
  [AND | OR | LIMIT limit | WITHVALUES | NOCASE [...]]
commands.description: Searches array elements in a range using textual predicates.

commands.name: ARINFO
commands.description: Returns metadata about an array.

commands.name: ARINSERT
commands.description: Inserts one or more values at consecutive indices.

commands.name: ARLASTITEMS
commands.description: Returns the most recently inserted elements.

commands.name: ARLEN
commands.description: Returns the length of an array (max index + 1).

commands.name: ARMGET
commands.description: Gets values at multiple indices in an array.

commands.name: ARMSET
commands.description: Sets multiple index-value pairs in an array.

commands.name: ARNEXT
commands.description: Returns the next index ARINSERT would use.

commands.name: AROP
commands.syntax:
AROP key start end <SUM | MIN | MAX | AND | OR | XOR | MATCH value |
  USED>
commands.description: Performs aggregate operations on array elements in a range.

commands.name: ARRING
commands.description: Inserts values into a ring buffer of specified size, wrapping and truncating as needed.

commands.name: ARSCAN
commands.description: Iterates existing elements in a range, returning index-value pairs.

commands.name: ARSEEK
commands.description: Sets the ARINSERT / ARRING cursor to a specific index.

commands.name: ARSET
commands.description: Sets one or more contiguous values starting at an index in an array.

commands.name: PFADD
commands.description: Adds elements to a HyperLogLog key. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

commands.name: PFCOUNT
commands.description: Returns the approximated cardinality of the set(s) observed by the HyperLogLog key(s).

commands.name: PFDEBUG
commands.description: Internal commands for debugging HyperLogLog values.

commands.name: PFMERGE
commands.description: Merges one or more HyperLogLog values into a single key.

commands.name: PFSELFTEST
commands.description: An internal command for testing HyperLogLog values.

commands.name: GEOADD
commands.syntax:
GEOADD key [NX | XX] [CH] longitude latitude member [longitude
  latitude member ...]
commands.description: Adds one or more members to a geospatial index. The key is created if it doesn't exist.

commands.name: GEODIST
commands.syntax: GEODIST key member1 member2 [M | KM | FT | MI]
commands.description: Returns the distance between two members of a geospatial index.

commands.name: GEOHASH
commands.description: Returns members from a geospatial index as geohash strings.

commands.name: GEOPOS
commands.description: Returns the longitude and latitude of members from a geospatial index.

commands.name: GEORADIUS
commands.syntax:
GEORADIUS key longitude latitude radius <M | KM | FT | MI>
  [WITHCOORD] [WITHDIST] [WITHHASH] [COUNT count [ANY]] [ASC | DESC]
  [STORE key | STOREDIST key]
commands.description: Queries a geospatial index for members within a distance from a coordinate, optionally stores the result.

commands.name: GEORADIUSBYMEMBER
commands.syntax:
GEORADIUSBYMEMBER key member radius <M | KM | FT | MI> [WITHCOORD]
  [WITHDIST] [WITHHASH] [COUNT count [ANY]] [ASC | DESC] [STORE key
  | STOREDIST key]
commands.description: Queries a geospatial index for members within a distance from a member, optionally stores the result.

commands.name: GEORADIUSBYMEMBER_RO
commands.syntax:
GEORADIUSBYMEMBER RO key member radius <M | KM | FT | MI>
  [WITHCOORD] [WITHDIST] [WITHHASH] [COUNT count [ANY]] [ASC | DESC]
commands.description: Returns members from a geospatial index that are within a distance from a member.

commands.name: GEORADIUS_RO
commands.syntax:
GEORADIUS RO key longitude latitude radius <M | KM | FT | MI>
  [WITHCOORD] [WITHDIST] [WITHHASH] [COUNT count [ANY]] [ASC | DESC]
commands.description: Returns members from a geospatial index that are within a distance from a coordinate.

commands.name: GEOSEARCH
commands.syntax:
GEOSEARCH key <FROMMEMBER member | FROMLONLAT longitude latitude>
  <BYRADIUS radius <M | KM | FT | MI> | BYBOX width height <M | KM |
  FT | MI>> [ASC | DESC] [COUNT count [ANY]] [WITHCOORD] [WITHDIST]
  [WITHHASH]
commands.description: Queries a geospatial index for members inside an area of a box or a circle.

commands.name: GEOSEARCHSTORE
commands.syntax:
GEOSEARCHSTORE destination source <FROMMEMBER member |
  FROMLONLAT longitude latitude> <BYRADIUS radius <M | KM | FT | MI>
  | BYBOX width height <M | KM | FT | MI>> [ASC | DESC] [COUNT count
  [ANY]] [STOREDIST]
commands.description: Queries a geospatial index for members inside an area of a box or a circle, optionally stores the result.

commands.name: JSON.ARRAPPEND

commands.name: JSON.ARRINDEX

commands.name: JSON.ARRINSERT
commands.description: Inserts the JSON scalar(s) value at the specified index in the array at path

commands.name: JSON.ARRLEN
commands.description: Returns the length of the array at path

commands.name: JSON.ARRPOP
commands.description: Removes and returns the element at the specified index in the array at path

commands.name: JSON.ARRTRIM
commands.description: Trims the array at path to contain only the specified inclusive range of indices from start to stop

commands.name: JSON.CLEAR
commands.description: Clears all values from an array or an object and sets numeric values to `0`

commands.name: JSON.DEBUG
commands.description: Debugging container command

commands.name: JSON.DEBUG MEMORY
commands.description: Reports the size in bytes of a key

commands.name: JSON.DEL
commands.description: Deletes a value

commands.name: JSON.FORGET
commands.description: Deletes a value

commands.name: JSON.GET

commands.name: JSON.MERGE
commands.description: Merges a given JSON value into matching paths. Consequently, JSON values at matching paths are updated, deleted, or expanded with new children

commands.name: JSON.MGET
commands.description: Returns the values at a path from one or more keys

commands.name: JSON.MSET
commands.syntax: JSON.MSET key path value [key path value ...]
commands.description: Sets or updates the JSON value of one or more keys

commands.name: JSON.NUMINCRBY
commands.description: Increments the numeric value at path by a value

commands.name: JSON.NUMMULTBY
commands.description: Multiplies the numeric value at path by a value

commands.name: JSON.OBJKEYS
commands.description: Returns the key names of JSON objects at the paths matching a given path expression

commands.name: JSON.OBJLEN
commands.description: Returns the number of keys in JSON objects at the paths matching a given path expression

commands.name: JSON.RESP
commands.description: Returns the JSON value at path in Redis Serialization Protocol (RESP)

commands.name: JSON.SET
commands.syntax: JSON.SET key path value [NX | XX] [FPHA <FP16 | BF16 | FP32 | FP64>]
commands.description: Sets or updates the JSON value at a path

commands.name: JSON.STRAPPEND
commands.description: Appends a string to JSON strings at the paths matching a given path expression

commands.name: JSON.STRLEN
commands.description: Returns the length of JSON strings at the paths matching a given path expression

commands.name: JSON.TOGGLE
commands.description: Toggles a boolean value

commands.name: JSON.TYPE
commands.description: Returns the type of the JSON value at path

commands.name: FT.AGGREGATE
commands.description: Run a search query on an index and perform aggregate transformations on the results

commands.name: FT.ALIASADD
commands.description: Adds an alias to the index

commands.name: FT.ALIASDEL
commands.description: Deletes an alias from the index

commands.name: FT.ALIASLIST
commands.description: Lists all aliases for the index

commands.name: FT.ALIASUPDATE
commands.description: Adds or updates an alias to the index

commands.name: FT.ALTER
commands.syntax: FT.ALTER index [SKIPINITIALSCAN] SCHEMA ADD field options
commands.description: Adds a new field to the index

commands.name: FT.CONFIG GET
commands.description: Retrieves runtime configuration options

commands.name: FT.CONFIG SET
commands.description: Sets runtime configuration options

commands.name: FT.CREATE
commands.syntax:
FT.CREATE index [ON <HASH | JSON>] [PREFIX count prefix [prefix
  ...]] [FILTER filter] [LANGUAGE default lang]
  [LANGUAGE FIELD lang attribute] [SCORE default score]
  [SCORE FIELD score attribute] [PAYLOAD FIELD payload attribute]
  [MAXTEXTFIELDS] [TEMPORARY seconds] [NOOFFSETS] [NOHL] [NOFIELDS]
  [NOFREQS] [STOPWORDS count [stopword [stopword ...]]]
  [SKIPINITIALSCAN] [INDEXALL <ENABLE | DISABLE>] SCHEMA field name [AS alias] <TEXT | TAG |
  NUMERIC | GEO | VECTOR> [WITHSUFFIXTRIE] [INDEXEMPTY]
  [INDEXMISSING] [SORTABLE [UNF]] [NOINDEX] [field name [AS alias]
  <TEXT | TAG | NUMERIC | GEO | VECTOR> [WITHSUFFIXTRIE]
  [INDEXEMPTY] [INDEXMISSING] [SORTABLE [UNF]] [NOINDEX] ...]
commands.description: Creates an index with the given spec

commands.name: FT.CURSOR DEL
commands.description: Deletes a cursor

commands.name: FT.CURSOR READ
commands.syntax: FT.CURSOR READ index cursor id [COUNT read size]
commands.description: Reads from a cursor

commands.name: FT.DICTADD
commands.description: Adds terms to a dictionary

commands.name: FT.DICTDEL
commands.description: Deletes terms from a dictionary

commands.name: FT.DICTDUMP
commands.description: Dumps all terms in the given dictionary

commands.name: FT.DROPINDEX
commands.description: Deletes the index

commands.name: FT.EXPLAIN
commands.description: Returns the execution plan for a complex query

commands.name: FT.EXPLAINCLI
commands.description: Returns the execution plan for a complex query

commands.name: FT.HYBRID
commands.syntax:
FT.HYBRID index
  SEARCH query
    [SCORER scorer]
    [YIELD SCORE AS name]
  VSIM vector field $vector param
    [KNN count K k [EF RUNTIME ef runtime]] [SHARD K RATIO shard k ratio]]
    [RANGE count RADIUS radius [EPSILON epsilon]]
    [YIELD SCORE AS name]
    [FILTER] count filter-expression [POLICY [ADHOC/BATCHES] BATCH SIZE batch-size-value]
  [COMBINE RRF count [CONSTANT constant] [WINDOW window] [YIELD SCORE AS name]]
  [COMBINE LINEAR count [[ALPHA alpha] [BETA beta]] [WINDOW window] [YIELD SCORE AS name]]
  [LIMIT offset num]
  [SORTBY count sortby [ASC | DESC]]
  [NOSORT]
  [LOAD count field [field ...]]
  [LOAD *]
  [GROUPBY nargs property [property ...]
  [GROUPBY nargs property [property ...]
    [REDUCE function nargs arg [arg ...] [AS name]
    [REDUCE function nargs arg [arg ...] [AS name] ...]] ...]]
  [APPLY expression AS name [APPLY expression AS name ...]]
  [FILTER filter]
  PARAMS nargs vector param vector blob [name value ...]
  [TIMEOUT timeout]
commands.description: Performs hybrid search combining text search and vector similarity search

commands.name: FT.INFO
commands.description: Returns information and statistics on the index

commands.name: FT.PROFILE
commands.syntax: FT.PROFILE index <SEARCH | HYBRID | AGGREGATE> [LIMITED] QUERY query
commands.description: Performs a `FT.SEARCH`, `FT.HYBRID`, or `FT.AGGREGATE` command and collects performance information

commands.name: FT.SEARCH
commands.syntax:
FT.SEARCH index query [NOCONTENT] [VERBATIM] [NOSTOPWORDS]
  [WITHSCORES] [WITHPAYLOADS] [WITHSORTKEYS] [FILTER numeric field
  min max [FILTER numeric field min max ...]] [GEOFILTER geo field
  lon lat radius <m | km | mi | ft> [GEOFILTER geo field lon lat
  radius <m | km | mi | ft> ...]] [INKEYS count key [key ...]]
  [INFIELDS count field [field ...]] [RETURN count identifier
  [AS property] [identifier [AS property] ...]] [SUMMARIZE
  [FIELDS count field [field ...]] [FRAGS num] [LEN fragsize]
  [SEPARATOR separator]] [HIGHLIGHT [FIELDS count field [field ...]]
  [TAGS open close]] [SLOP slop] [TIMEOUT timeout] [INORDER]
  [LANGUAGE language] [EXPANDER expander] [SCORER scorer]
  [EXPLAINSCORE] [PAYLOAD payload] [SORTBY sortby [ASC | DESC]]
  [LIMIT offset num] [PARAMS nargs name value [name value ...]]
  [DIALECT dialect]
commands.description: Searches the index with a textual query, returning either documents or just ids

commands.name: FT.SPELLCHECK
commands.syntax:
FT.SPELLCHECK index query [DISTANCE distance] [TERMS <INCLUDE |
  EXCLUDE> dictionary [terms [terms ...]]] [DIALECT dialect]
commands.description: Performs spelling correction on a query, returning suggestions for misspelled terms

commands.name: FT.SYNDUMP
commands.description: Dumps the contents of a synonym group

commands.name: FT.SYNUPDATE
commands.syntax:
FT.SYNUPDATE index synonym group id [SKIPINITIALSCAN] term [term
  ...]
commands.description: Creates or updates a synonym group with additional terms

commands.name: FT.TAGVALS
commands.description: Returns the distinct tags indexed in a Tag field

commands.name: FT._LIST
commands.description: Returns a list of all existing indexes

commands.name: TS.ADD
commands.syntax:
TS.ADD key timestamp value [RETENTION retentionPeriod]
  [ENCODING <UNCOMPRESSED | COMPRESSED>] [CHUNK SIZE size]
  [ON DUPLICATE <BLOCK | FIRST | LAST | MIN | MAX | SUM>]
  [LABELS label value [label value ...]]
commands.description: Append a sample to a time series

commands.name: TS.ALTER
commands.syntax:
TS.ALTER key [RETENTION retentionPeriod] [CHUNK SIZE size]
  [DUPLICATE POLICY <BLOCK | FIRST | LAST | MIN | MAX | SUM>] [LABELS label value
  [label value ...]]
commands.description: Update the retention, chunk size, duplicate policy, and labels of an existing time series

commands.name: TS.CREATE
commands.syntax:
TS.CREATE key [RETENTION retentionPeriod] [ENCODING <UNCOMPRESSED |
  COMPRESSED>] [CHUNK SIZE size] [DUPLICATE POLICY <BLOCK | FIRST |
  LAST | MIN | MAX | SUM>] [LABELS label value [label value ...]]
commands.description: Create a new time series

commands.name: TS.CREATERULE
commands.syntax:
TS.CREATERULE sourceKey destKey AGGREGATION <AVG | FIRST | LAST |
  MIN | MAX | SUM | RANGE | COUNT | STD.P | STD.S | VAR.P | VAR.S |
  TWA> bucketDuration [alignTimestamp]
commands.description: Create a compaction rule

commands.name: TS.DECRBY
commands.syntax:
TS.DECRBY key value [TIMESTAMP timestamp]
  [RETENTION retentionPeriod] [UNCOMPRESSED] [CHUNK SIZE size]
  [LABELS label value [label value ...]]
commands.description: Decrease the value of the sample with the maximum existing timestamp, or create a new sample with a value equal to the value of the sample with the maximum existing timestamp with a given decrement

commands.name: TS.DEL
commands.syntax: TS.DEL key from timestamp to timestamp
commands.description: Delete all samples between two timestamps for a given time series

commands.name: TS.DELETERULE
commands.description: Delete a compaction rule

commands.name: TS.GET
commands.description: Get the sample with the highest timestamp from a given time series

commands.name: TS.INCRBY
commands.syntax:
TS.INCRBY key value [TIMESTAMP timestamp]
  [RETENTION retentionPeriod] [UNCOMPRESSED] [CHUNK SIZE size]
  [LABELS label value [label value ...]]
commands.description: Increase the value of the sample with the maximum existing timestamp, or create a new sample with a value equal to the value of the sample with the maximum existing timestamp with a given increment

commands.name: TS.INFO
commands.description: Returns information and statistics for a time series

commands.name: TS.MADD
commands.syntax: TS.MADD key timestamp value [key timestamp value ...]
commands.description: Append new samples to one or more time series

commands.name: TS.MGET
commands.syntax:
TS.MGET [LATEST] [WITHLABELS | SELECTED LABELS label1 [label1 ...]]
  FILTER <l=v | l!=v | l= | l!= | l=(v1,v2,...) | l!=(v1,v2,...)
  [l=v | l!=v | l= | l!= | l=(v1,v2,...) | l!=(v1,v2,...) ...]>
commands.description: Get the sample with the highest timestamp from each time series matching a specific filter

commands.name: TS.MRANGE
commands.syntax:
TS.MRANGE fromTimestamp toTimestamp [LATEST] [FILTER BY TS Timestamp
  [Timestamp ...]] [FILTER BY VALUE min max] [WITHLABELS |
  SELECTED LABELS label1 [label1 ...]] [COUNT count] [[ALIGN value]
  AGGREGATION aggregators bucketDuration [BUCKETTIMESTAMP]
  [EMPTY]] FILTER <l=v | l!=v | l= | l!= | l=(v1,v2,...) |
  l!=(v1,v2,...) [l=v | l!=v | l= | l!= | l=(v1,v2,...) |
  l!=(v1,v2,...) ...]> [GROUPBY label REDUCE reducer] [EXCLUDEEMPTY]
commands.description: Query a range across multiple time series by filters in forward direction

commands.name: TS.MREVRANGE
commands.syntax:
TS.MREVRANGE fromTimestamp toTimestamp [LATEST]
  [FILTER BY TS Timestamp [Timestamp ...]] [FILTER BY VALUE min max]
  [WITHLABELS | SELECTED LABELS label1 [label1 ...]] [COUNT count]
  [[ALIGN value] AGGREGATION aggregators bucketDuration
  [BUCKETTIMESTAMP] [EMPTY]] FILTER <l=v | l!=v | l= | l!= |
  l=(v1,v2,...) | l!=(v1,v2,...) [l=v | l!=v | l= | l!= |
  l=(v1,v2,...) | l!=(v1,v2,...) ...]> [GROUPBY label REDUCE
  reducer] [EXCLUDEEMPTY]
commands.description: Query a range across multiple time-series by filters in reverse direction

commands.name: TS.NRANGE
commands.syntax:
TS.NRANGE numkeys key [key ...] fromTimestamp toTimestamp [LATEST]
  [FILTER BY TS ts [ts ...]] [FILTER BY VALUE min max] [COUNT count]
  [[ALIGN align] AGGREGATION aggregators [aggregators ...] bucketDuration
  [BUCKETTIMESTAMP <start | - | end | + | mid | ~>] [EMPTY]]
commands.description: Query a range across multiple time series in forward direction, returning the results grouped by timestamp

commands.name: TS.NREVRANGE
commands.syntax:
TS.NREVRANGE numkeys key [key ...] fromTimestamp toTimestamp
  [LATEST] [FILTER BY TS ts [ts ...]] [FILTER BY VALUE min max]
  [COUNT count] [[ALIGN align] AGGREGATION aggregators [aggregators ...]
  bucketDuration [BUCKETTIMESTAMP <start | - | end | + | mid | ~>]
  [EMPTY]]
commands.description: Query a range across multiple time series in reverse direction, returning the results grouped by timestamp

commands.name: TS.QUERYINDEX
commands.description: Get all time series keys matching a filter list

commands.name: TS.QUERYLABELS
commands.description: Get all label names, or all values of a given label, for time series matching a filter list, or all series

commands.name: TS.RANGE
commands.syntax:
TS.RANGE key fromTimestamp toTimestamp [LATEST]
  [FILTER BY TS Timestamp [Timestamp ...]] [FILTER BY VALUE min max]
  [COUNT count] [[ALIGN value] AGGREGATION aggregators bucketDuration [BUCKETTIMESTAMP] [EMPTY]]
commands.description: Query a range in forward direction

commands.name: TS.READ
commands.syntax:
TS.READ key timestamp [BLOCK milliseconds min count]
  [MAX COUNT max count]
commands.description: Read: return up to max_count samples with timestamp >= timestamp. With BLOCK, waits up to milliseconds ms until at least min_count qualifying samples exist

commands.name: TS.REVRANGE
commands.syntax:
TS.REVRANGE key fromTimestamp toTimestamp [LATEST]
  [FILTER BY TS Timestamp [Timestamp ...]] [FILTER BY VALUE min max]
  [COUNT count] [[ALIGN value] AGGREGATION aggregators
  bucketDuration [BUCKETTIMESTAMP] [EMPTY]]
commands.description: Query a range in reverse direction

commands.name: VISMEMBER

commands.name: VLINKS

commands.name: VRANDMEMBER
commands.description: Return one or multiple random members from a vector set.

commands.name: VRANGE
commands.description: Return elements in a lexicographical range

commands.name: VREM
commands.description: Remove an element from a vector set.

commands.name: VSETATTR
commands.description: Associate or remove the JSON attributes of elements.

commands.name: VSIM

  [TRUTH] [NOTHREAD]

commands.name: UNSUBSCRIBE

commands.description: Returns the effective values of configuration parameters.

commands.name: CONFIG RESETSTAT
commands.description: Resets the server's statistics.

commands.name: CONFIG REWRITE
commands.description: Persists the effective configuration to file.

commands.name: CONFIG SET
commands.description: Sets configuration parameters in-flight.

commands.name: DBSIZE
commands.description: Returns the number of keys in the database.

commands.name: FAILOVER
commands.description: Starts a coordinated failover from a server to one of its replicas.

commands.name: FLUSHALL
commands.description: Removes all keys from all databases.

commands.name: FLUSHDB
commands.description: Remove all keys from the current database.

commands.name: HOTKEYS
commands.description: A container for hotkeys tracking commands.

commands.name: HOTKEYS GET
commands.description: Returns lists of top K hotkeys depending on metrics chosen in HOTKEYS START command.

commands.name: HOTKEYS RESET
commands.description: Release the resources used for hotkey tracking.

commands.name: HOTKEYS START
commands.syntax: HOTKEYS START METRICS count [CPU] [NET] [COUNT k] [DURATION seconds] [SAMPLE ratio] [SLOTS count slot [slot ...]]
commands.description: Starts hotkeys tracking.

commands.name: HOTKEYS STOP
commands.description: Stops hotkeys tracking.

commands.name: INFO
commands.description: Returns information and statistics about the server.

commands.name: LASTSAVE
commands.description: Returns the Unix timestamp of the last successful save to disk.

commands.name: LATENCY DOCTOR
commands.description: Returns a human-readable latency analysis report.

commands.name: LATENCY GRAPH
commands.description: Returns a latency graph for an event.

commands.name: LATENCY HISTOGRAM
commands.description: Returns the cumulative distribution of latencies of a subset or all commands.

commands.name: LATENCY HISTORY
commands.description: Returns timestamp-latency samples for an event.

commands.name: LATENCY LATEST
commands.description: Returns the latest latency samples for all events.

commands.name: LATENCY RESET
commands.description: Resets the latency data for one or more events.

commands.name: LOLWUT
commands.description: Displays computer art and the Redis version

commands.name: MEMORY DOCTOR
commands.description: Outputs a memory problems report.

commands.name: MEMORY MALLOC-STATS
commands.description: Returns the allocator statistics.

commands.name: MEMORY PURGE
commands.description: Asks the allocator to release memory.

commands.name: MEMORY STATS
commands.description: Returns details about memory usage.

commands.name: MEMORY USAGE
commands.description: Estimates the memory usage of a key.

commands.name: MODULE LIST
commands.description: Returns all loaded modules.

commands.name: MODULE LOAD
commands.description: Loads a module.

commands.name: MODULE LOADEX
commands.syntax:
MODULE LOADEX path [CONFIG name value [CONFIG name value ...]]
  [ARGS args [args ...]]
commands.description: Loads a module using extended parameters.

commands.name: MODULE UNLOAD
commands.description: Unloads a module.

commands.name: MONITOR
commands.description: Listens for all requests received by the server in real-time.

commands.name: PSYNC
commands.description: An internal command used in replication.

commands.name: REPLCONF
commands.description: An internal command for configuring the replication stream.

commands.name: REPLICAOF
commands.description: Configures a server as replica of another, or promotes it to a master.

commands.name: RESTORE-ASKING
commands.syntax:
RESTORE-ASKING key ttl serialized-value [REPLACE] [ABSTTL]
  [IDLETIME seconds] [FREQ frequency]
commands.description: An internal command for migrating keys in a cluster.

commands.name: ROLE
commands.description: Returns the replication role.

commands.name: SAVE
commands.description: Synchronously saves the database(s) to disk.

commands.name: SHUTDOWN
commands.description: Synchronously saves the database(s) to disk and shuts down the Redis server.

commands.name: SLAVEOF
commands.description: Sets a Redis server as a replica of another, or promotes it to being a master.

commands.name: SLOWLOG GET
commands.description: Returns the slow log's entries.

commands.name: SLOWLOG LEN
commands.description: Returns the number of entries in the slow log.

commands.name: SLOWLOG RESET
commands.description: Clears all entries from the slow log.

commands.name: SWAPDB
commands.description: Swaps two Redis databases.

commands.name: SYNC
commands.description: An internal command used in replication.

commands.name: TIME
commands.description: Returns the server time.

commands.name: ASKING
commands.description: Signals that a cluster client is following an -ASK redirect.

commands.name: CLUSTER ADDSLOTS
commands.description: Assigns new hash slots to a node.

commands.name: CLUSTER ADDSLOTSRANGE
commands.description: Assigns new hash slot ranges to a node.

commands.name: CLUSTER BUMPEPOCH
commands.description: Advances the cluster config epoch.

commands.name: CLUSTER COUNT-FAILURE-REPORTS
commands.description: Returns the number of active failure reports active for a node.

commands.name: CLUSTER COUNTKEYSINSLOT
commands.description: Returns the number of keys in a hash slot.

commands.name: CLUSTER DELSLOTS
commands.description: Sets hash slots as unbound for a node.

commands.name: CLUSTER DELSLOTSRANGE
commands.description: Sets hash slot ranges as unbound for a node.

commands.name: CLUSTER FAILOVER
commands.description: Forces a replica to perform a manual failover of its master.

commands.name: CLUSTER FLUSHSLOTS
commands.description: Deletes all slots information from a node.

commands.name: CLUSTER FORGET
commands.description: Removes a node from the nodes table.

commands.name: CLUSTER GETKEYSINSLOT
commands.description: Returns the key names in a hash slot.

commands.name: CLUSTER INFO
commands.description: Returns information about the state of a node.

commands.name: CLUSTER KEYSLOT
commands.description: Returns the hash slot for a key.

commands.name: CLUSTER LINKS
commands.description: Returns a list of all TCP links to and from peer nodes.

commands.name: CLUSTER MEET
commands.description: Forces a node to handshake with another node.

commands.name: CLUSTER MIGRATION
commands.syntax:
CLUSTER MIGRATION <IMPORT start-slot end-slot
  [start-slot end-slot ...] | CANCEL <ID task-id | ALL> |
  STATUS <[ID task-id] | [ALL]>>
commands.description: Start, monitor, and cancel atomic slot migration tasks.

commands.name: CLUSTER MYID
commands.description: Returns the ID of a node.

commands.name: CLUSTER MYSHARDID
commands.description: Returns the shard ID of a node.

commands.name: CLUSTER NODES
commands.description: Returns the cluster configuration for a node.

commands.name: CLUSTER REPLICAS
commands.description: Lists the replica nodes of a master node.

commands.name: CLUSTER REPLICATE
commands.description: Configure a node as replica of a master node.

commands.name: CLUSTER RESET
commands.description: Resets a node.

commands.name: CLUSTER SAVECONFIG
commands.description: Forces a node to save the cluster configuration to disk.

commands.name: CLUSTER SET-CONFIG-EPOCH
commands.description: Sets the configuration epoch for a new node.

commands.name: CLUSTER SETSLOT
commands.syntax:
CLUSTER SETSLOT slot <IMPORTING node-id | MIGRATING node-id |
  NODE node-id | STABLE>
commands.description: Binds a hash slot to a node.

commands.name: CLUSTER SHARDS
commands.description: Returns the mapping of cluster slots to shards.

commands.name: CLUSTER SLAVES
commands.description: Lists the replica nodes of a master node.

commands.name: CLUSTER SLOT-STATS
commands.syntax:
CLUSTER SLOT-STATS <SLOTSRANGE start-slot end-slot | ORDERBY metric
  [LIMIT limit] [ASC | DESC]>
commands.description: Return an array of slot usage statistics for slots assigned to the current node.

commands.name: CLUSTER SLOTS
commands.description: Returns the mapping of cluster slots to nodes.

commands.name: READONLY
commands.description: Enables read-only queries for a connection to a Redis Cluster replica node.

commands.name: READWRITE
commands.description: Enables read-write queries for a connection to a Reids Cluster replica node.

commands.name: COPY
commands.description: Copies the value of a key to a new key.

commands.name: DEL
commands.description: Deletes one or more keys.

commands.name: DUMP
commands.description: Returns a serialized representation of the value stored at a key.

commands.name: EXISTS
commands.description: Determines whether one or more keys exist.

commands.name: EXPIRE
commands.syntax: EXPIRE key seconds [NX | XX | GT | LT]
commands.description: Sets the expiration time of a key in seconds.

commands.name: EXPIREAT
commands.syntax: EXPIREAT key unix-time-seconds [NX | XX | GT | LT]
commands.description: Sets the expiration time of a key to a Unix timestamp.

commands.name: EXPIRETIME
commands.description: Returns the expiration time of a key as a Unix timestamp.

commands.name: KEYS
commands.description: Returns all key names that match a pattern.

commands.name: MIGRATE
commands.syntax:
MIGRATE host port <key | ""> destination-db timeout [COPY] [REPLACE]
  [AUTH password | AUTH2 username password] [KEYS key [key ...]]
commands.description: Atomically transfers a key from one Redis instance to another.

commands.name: MOVE
commands.description: Moves a key to another database.

commands.name: OBJECT ENCODING
commands.description: Returns the internal encoding of a Redis object.

commands.name: OBJECT FREQ
commands.description: Returns the logarithmic access frequency counter of a Redis object.

commands.name: OBJECT IDLETIME
commands.description: Returns the time since the last access to a Redis object.

commands.name: OBJECT REFCOUNT
commands.description: Returns the reference count of a value of a key.

commands.name: PERSIST
commands.description: Removes the expiration time of a key.

commands.name: PEXPIRE
commands.syntax: PEXPIRE key milliseconds [NX | XX | GT | LT]
commands.description: Sets the expiration time of a key in milliseconds.

commands.name: PEXPIREAT
commands.syntax: PEXPIREAT key unix-time-milliseconds [NX | XX | GT | LT]
commands.description: Sets the expiration time of a key to a Unix milliseconds timestamp.

commands.name: PEXPIRETIME
commands.description: Returns the expiration time of a key as a Unix milliseconds timestamp.

commands.name: PTTL
commands.description: Returns the expiration time in milliseconds of a key.

commands.name: RANDOMKEY
commands.description: Returns a random key name from the database.

commands.name: RENAME
commands.description: Renames a key and overwrites the destination.

commands.name: RENAMENX
commands.description: Renames a key only when the target key name doesn't exist.

commands.name: RESTORE
commands.syntax:
RESTORE key ttl serialized-value [REPLACE] [ABSTTL]
  [IDLETIME seconds] [FREQ frequency]
commands.description: Creates a key from the serialized representation of a value.

commands.name: SCAN
commands.description: Iterates over the key names in the database.

commands.name: SORT
commands.syntax:
SORT key [BY pattern] [LIMIT offset count] [GET pattern [GET pattern
  ...]] [ASC | DESC] [ALPHA] [STORE destination]
commands.description: Sorts the elements in a list, a set, or a sorted set, optionally storing the result.

commands.name: SORT_RO
commands.syntax:
SORT RO key [BY pattern] [LIMIT offset count] [GET pattern [GET
  pattern ...]] [ASC | DESC] [ALPHA]
commands.description: Returns the sorted elements of a list, a set, or a sorted set.

commands.name: TOUCH
commands.description: Returns the number of existing keys out of those specified after updating the time they were last accessed.

commands.name: TTL
commands.description: Returns the expiration time in seconds of a key.

commands.name: TYPE
commands.description: Determines the type of value stored at a key.

commands.name: UNLINK
commands.description: Asynchronously deletes one or more keys.

commands.name: WAIT
commands.description: Blocks until the asynchronous replication of all preceding write commands sent by the connection is completed.

commands.name: WAITAOF
commands.description: Blocks until all of the preceding write commands sent by the connection are written to the append-only file of the master and/or replicas.
